title: Javanese speech levels (tingkat tutur), AI models on items split into two abilities that are never summed. Per-item verdicts for the public slice, so the per-model summary can be recomputed rather than trusted: 38 machine-scored multiple-choice items for recognising the right register, and 8 open items graded one by one by a native speaker under a weighted rubric. Includes three models quantised to 4 bits and run on local hardware, whose cost is blank rather than zero. Items and key withheld, figures only. See PROVENANCE
